user.title: Connect to 2core
user.description: Enter the local 2core server address and access key. Tucor credentials stay on that server.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect or controller inventory is not ready. Check the server address and status.

init.title: Timed runs and weather
init.description: Weather inputs are optional. Choose Tempest rain intensity and recent accumulation (today or rolling 24 hours, never a lifetime total). An optional weather entity must supply a complete 12-hour hourly rain forecast. Choose Observe first in the Weather mode entity; Automatic enables rain delays when live controls are enabled on the server.
